question: The installation of the Pokhran model, firefly bird diverters, is related to the protection of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Indian bustard**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the protection of critically endangered **Great Indian bustard**, **the Wildlife Conservation Society- India (WCSI)**

 
 
• **​**It installed **1,848 bird diverters on high-tension wires along a 6.5km stretch in Pokhran, Rajasthan.**
